page.notes: Printed mark before "tionem" at the start of the first line is a stray mark and is not transcribed. "ferenilf.noftrun" is hard to read; the last letters are marked [?]. Catchword "animo" and signature "Ee 4" are at the foot. Running head is taken as "IN REGNO SCOTIÆ. 1640." with page number 439 at the top right.
